_meta.source: KatFish (Park et al., ACL 2025) human texts only for ranges; LLM columns summarise GPT-4o/Solar/Qwen2-72B/Llama3.1-70B outputs. Kiwi (kiwipiepy 0.24.0) morphology.
_meta.unit_notes: sentence unit = Kiwi sentence (essay, abstract) or line (poetry). *_per_sent: per unit. *_per100m: per 100 Kiwi morphemes. rates in 0..1.
_meta.natural_range_definition: natural_range = [p25, p75] of HUMAN documents in that genre. p10/p90 give a wider tolerance band. Ranges describe the KatFish human populations (school students for essay, 2016-2018 NLP-paper authors for abstract, hobby/student poets for poetry) -- NOT a norm for adult professional prose.
_meta.status: separates = CI excludes 0.5 (doc and cluster bootstrap), |AUC-0.5|>=0.10, survives length stratification and caliper matching, same direction vs all generators; noise = otherwise weak; length / length-confounded / generator-inconsistent as named.
_meta.use_policy: Diagnostic ranges for source-anchored, meaning-preserving edits only. Do NOT use as detector-evasion targets and do not push a text towards the median (human medians for rates such as comma_* are 0 in poetry).
_meta.licence_note: Only aggregate statistics are included; no KatFish text. The KatFish repository declares no licence (api.github.com license:null as recorded in docs/research/super-sejong/B-ai-korean-features.md); upstream corpora (AI-Hub essays, NIKL poems, KISS/KCI abstracts) have their own terms. Clear with the authors before shipping derived data.
